Problem Statement
Read the price of a spare part and the discount percentage. Print the discount amount and the final price.
Description
A shop sells machine spare parts. The price of a part and the discount percentage are given. Read them, find the discount amount and the final price after the discount, and print both with exactly 2 digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
Two integers, each on a separate line: the price of the part (in rupees) and the discount percentage. (1 <= price <= 100000, 0 <= discount percentage <= 100)
Output Description
Print the discount amount on the first line and the final price on the second line. Both must have exactly 2 digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
1000
10
Sample Output
100.00
900.00
